_how: js/site.js reads this once and loads ONLY what is named here (no probing, no 404s). Each type lists its strip in order: the FIRST frame is the one-house render (the same white ranch house with that ADU type lit), then Hayden's keepers (2026-09-14 evening review). Names resolve: 'frames/x' -> images/frames/ (the q84 progressive re-encodes the page loads, native px), 'bubbles/x' -> images/bubbles/, anything else -> images/concepts/ (the untouched originals; see _sources).
_stills_only: 2026-09-14 evening (Hayden): NO push-in clips — the bubbles show stills only and every type opens on frame 1. The clip code, the clips block and the clip posters are gone from the manifest; the video files stay on disk in images/bubbles/ unlisted.
_relit: Every keeper that wasn't already dusk was RELIT to the hero's blue hour with Higgsfield nano_banana_pro (same composition, only the light changed — structure-checked, see NOTES.md). The daylight originals stay untouched in images/concepts/.
_captions: captions[frame] = the one line under that frame: what changed on THIS house, in plain words. Frames without one get 'Another lot, same idea.'
